title: Transfection of bone marrow-derived mast cells for transcription factor luciferase reporter assays
protocol: Maturate mast cells from bone marrow using interleukin 3.
Isolate bone from femurs and tibias of 8-12 week old Pac-1-/- and Pac-1+/+ mice.
Grow cells at 4×10^5 cells/mL in RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with components as specified.
Maintain cultures for 4-6 weeks at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Assess cell positivity by fluorescein isothiocyanate-labelled anti-c-kit and anti-DNP IgE antibodies using flow cytometry.
Evaluate cell morphology by cytospin and staining with giemsa and toluidine blue.
Sensitise cells with anti-DNP IgE mAb at 100 ng/mL for 18 hours.
Wash cells twice to remove unbound IgE.
Stimulate cells with 20 ng/mL of DNP-HSA for chosen times.
Transfect 4 x 10^6 BMMCs with 1.75 μg pG5E4D38-Luc and 1.75 μg pSG-Gal-Elk-1 plasmids.
Transfect cells with 1 μg of lacZ-expression vector pCMVβ using solution T and an Amaxa nucleofector device set to program T-016.
Mock-transfect cells with PBS to measure background luciferase and β-galactosidase activities.
Transfect BMMCs with 1 μg pCMVβ and 3.5 μg of the NFAT reporter plasmid pNFAT-Luc.
Plate BMMCs in 3 mL culture medium (RPMI 1640 supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, penicillin, streptomycin, L-glutamine, β-mercaptoethanol, HEPES, and recombinant murine IL-3).
Allow the cells to recover for 24 hours.
Sensitise BMMCs with 100 ng/mL anti-DNP IgE antibodies for 18 hours.
Split the cells.
Stimulate with 20 ng/mL DNP-HSA for 6 h (Elk-1) or 8 h (NFAT:AP-1).
Leave untreated as a control condition.
Lysis the cells in luciferase lysis buffer.
Determine raw luciferase activities using a luciferase activity kit.
Measure β-galactosidase (β-gal) activities using Galactostar and Galacton reagents.
Subtract background β-gal activity of mock-transfected cells from transfected BMMCs lysates.
Calculate relative β-gal activity for each sample.
Divide the luciferase activity of each sample by the corresponding relative β-gal activity to obtain standardized luciferase activity.
Transfect mast cells with 2 μg of WT Pac-1.
Transfect mast cells with 2 μg of C257S Pac-1.
Transfect mast cells with 2 μg of pMIG vector control.
